description: Fabric mod: save and switch between multiple keybind layouts, covering vanilla and mod-registered keybinds alike.

mods.name: KeyConfigs
mods.description: Save and switch between multiple keybind layouts (PvP, building, survival, etc.), including keybinds registered by other mods.

releases.notes:
Backport of v0.1.0 to Minecraft 1.21.11.

Same feature set as the 26.1.2 release:
- Save named keybind profiles (vanilla + any mod's keybinds)
- Switch profiles from an in-game menu (default key: K)
- Rename, capture-current, and delete (with confirmation) profiles
- Optional cycle-profile keybind (unbound by default)

Requires Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader >= 0.19.3, Fabric API, Java >= 21.
